findings.problem: The guide only requests a generic source-base-to-tested-subject manifest. It does not name source base 5af5c5c or require the accepted-run, integration, merged-PR and closed-blocker identities for #75-#78, so an operator cannot independently establish the candidate is bound to the approved native frontier.
findings.required_change: Amend TC-10 to name source base 5af5c5c and require collection, validation and release-evidence capture of #75-#78 accepted-run, integration, merged-PR and closed-state identities before execution; reject any absent or inconsistent identity.

findings.problem: The guide prohibits suppression but does not name the focused root-CWD node/literal lifecycle invocations or require collection/execution and assertion-bearing source integrity evidence. The regression could be weakened or substituted without a detectable failure.
findings.required_change: Specify the exact root-CWD focused pytest node and Alembic lifecycle commands using the pinned interpreter and KNORA_DATABASE_URL; require collection/execution identity and before/after test, fixture and configuration integrity evidence; reject skip, xfail, deselection, backend-CWD substitution and weakening.
